testcase.name: the dessert carries its sourced range as the evidence of the estimate
a nut paste is a nut, not pasta or butter
completo is the hot dog profile
a specific profile still wins over the one of an ingredient word
a plural or an accent does not hide a keyword
the frying fat stays additive on the new profiles
a keyword inside a longer word does not name the food
tres leches and every other dessert are the dessert profile
the other profiles and an unmatched name keep the generic bounds
the evidence and the estimate agree on what a word matches
flan, mousse and budin are the custard profile and not the cake that dominates the dessert
the words that hold a keyword by themselves keep it
a salad of vegetables is dressed and one of fruit, protein or starch is that food
papas a lo pobre carry the fried egg and the fried onion and an empanada is its own profile
an iced drink is not a dessert
